name: How do I choose the right contractor for a foreclosed home kitchen refresh?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a foreclosed home kitchen refresh?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a contractor with proven hands-on restoration experience, proper credentials, and direct trade coordination. Foreclosed properties present unpredictable issues like water damage, abandoned wiring, and missing finish elements that standard installers might not want to touch. Choose a business with verified credentials, such as an A+ BBB rating, and confirm that the principal lead will be on-site rather than delegating the project entirely to revolving subcontractors. A contractor skilled in diverse tasks—including custom framing, drywall repair, tile setting, and finish carpentry—can pivot immediately when surprises appear behind old kitchen walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select an accredited, hands-on contractor experienced in rehabs who directly handles carpentry, tile, and drywall while coordinating needed mechanical trades on-site.
